name: homecare-platform
description: Home healthcare platform - public site, API and operations portal

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
